knowledge.purpose: Generic flex layout box that arranges its children in a row or column with gap, padding, and alignment
useCases: Group related blocks horizontally or vertically
Add consistent spacing between siblings without bespoke CSS
Wrap a child to apply a background or rounded corner
antiPatterns: Fixed-column responsive layouts — use layout.grid for those
Section-level page banding — use layout.section for full-bleed regions
Nesting containers many levels deep just to add margin — flatten the tree
knowledge.implementation:
Further anti-patterns:
- Creating an empty container then filling it in a later step — add the container WITH its children inline in one step (an empty + filled pair renders a blank duplicate)

Further use cases:
- Split a screen area into balanced left/right or top/bottom regions

Stacking law: on xs a row with two or more non-intrinsic children is drawn as a column; set keepRow: true only for ratio compositions where the side-by-side proportion is the design (mosaics, poster grids).

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner padding in px. Defaults to 16 when the container paints a ground or border, to 0 when it only arranges — a pure layout container adds no space of its own.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: CSS aspect-ratio for the box, e.g. '16/9', '4/3', '1/1', '21/9', '3/2', or a number. Sets the ratio without forcing a fixed height.

props.name: backgroundGradient
props.description: A CSS gradient painted over backgroundColor (e.g. linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pw-color-primary), var(--pw-color-accent))).

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Border colour; defaults to var(--pw-color-border) when only borderWidth is given.

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Border width in px; defaults to 1 when only borderColor is given.

props.name: keepRow
props.description: Exception that keeps the row from turning into a column on xs screens; for ratio compositions. Applied by the runtime.
